body:
So I went down to San Antonio for a metal concert. Some drunk guy who was huge , got into a fight with me, I stood up for myself but ended up with a huge gash on my lip. It got infected and was hurting pretty bad, it was stitched up. So I took some Oxy for the pain.
Impatient I crushed it up and snorted it. With in minutes I'm cradled in warmth. Floating amongst bliss. A sat and stared off for hours. Completely forgetting the pain, I listen to music and relax.
